anomalies.observed: The EPD boost-converter MOSFET Q2 is given the value MCH3478-TL-W, but its footprint and libsource part are for MCH3478-TL-H, whose package fields identify it as SC-70FL / MCPH-3 rather than SOT-23.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires the PDI-recommended boost switch Q1/Q2 to be MCH3478-TL-W in a SOT-23 package.

evidence.quote: Q1 MCH3478-TL-W (N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23, 30 V/2 A)

anomalies.impact: The board may be assembled with the wrong package or the specified SOT-23 part may not fit the assigned footprint, creating an assembly/sourcing mismatch for the EPD boost switch.
